༄༅/ /rgyal chen rnam thos sras kyi gtor chen dngos grub kyi rgya mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rgyal chen rnam thos sras kyi gtor chen dngos grub

kyi rgya mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / na mo gu ru badz+ra pā ṇa ye/ dpal 'byor dge legs rgya mtsho'i pha rol na/ skal bzang 'gro la phan bde'i dga' ston 'gyed/ /ma rungs bdud kyi stobs las rnam rgyal ba/ /bla ma dam pa rdo rje can la 'dud/ /sa brgyad dbang phyug rgyal sras rin chen mang*/ /nam mkha' mdzod kyi phun tshogs char chen gyis/ /skye dgu'i phan bde'i lo thog rgyas byed pa/ /gnas bsrung rnam thos bu yis dge legs mdzod/ /bstan bsrung mthu chen dpal ldan ngal bsos po/ /'gro ba skyabs phyir sgrub dang mchod gtor gyis/ /mnyes par byed pa'i rim pa 'dir bkod kyi/ /gegs med dngos grub rnam gnyis myur du sgrubs/ /'dir sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis gdul bya'i gtso bo rdo rje theg pa'i lam la mos shing*| khyad par dpal phyag na rdo rje la yi dam du 'dzin pa/ bstan pa rin po che 'phrin las rnam bzhi'i sgo nas rgyas par byed pa'i bsam sbyor la gnas shing*/ rang don du rdzas la sred pa dang bral ba'i gang zag gis rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi sras bsgrub cing*/ mchod gtor gyis mnyes par 'dod pas/ gnas gtsang zhing yid du 'ong ba byi dor gyis skyon dang bral bar byas/ dri bzang gis byugs shing gtor nas/ rgyan gyi bkod pa phun sum tshogs pas spras par/ spyir sku gsung thugs kyi rten dang*/ khyad par phyag na rdo rje dang*/ rgyal po chen po'i sku gzugs la sogs bgram/ grub na ba byung lnga dang dri bzang gis byugs pa'i man+ṭal me tog ser po'i tshom bu dgus brgyan pa yang bya/ de dag gi spyan sngar mchod pa 'byor tshad khyad par me tog ser po'i phreng ba'i snod dang*/ gos zung ser po la sogs pa dang spos dkar dang*/ 'bras phye dang*/ gu gul gyi bdug pa dang*| rin po che'i snod bzang po gas chag med pa'i nang du gtor ma nas sam 'bras dkar mo'i phye la rin po che brdar zhing mar dang 'o ma'am chu gtsang gis sbrus pa las byas pa'i ri rab bang rim bzhi pa zur bzhi pa zur bzhi la rin po che 'bar ba bzhi cog gi tshul du yod pa'i steng du rgyal po'i pho brang gru bzhi pa rgya :phubs

[ phibs ] gsum rtsegs kyi rnam pa nyi zla dang rin po che'i tog gis mdzes pa la rgyal mtshan btsugs pa grub na phyogs bzhir gling bzhi gling phran gyi rnam pas bskor ba'i phyir rta bdag gi khang brtsegs brgyad dang*/ 'khor sa rim pa gsum gyi phyi rol du bum pa bzang po la sogs pa/ 'og gi mngon rtogs kyi skabs nas 'byung ba lta bu/ ma 'byor na pho brang dbus ma'i bkod pa gang 'grub dang*| gzhan yang*/ rin po che dang*/ gos dar/ sha mar/ ja la sogs pa'i spyan gzigs bzang po dang bcas pa bsham par bya'o/ /de nas rang nyid bsgrub pa'i grogs dang bcas pa khrus dang gtsang sbra legs par byas shing*/ gos gsar pa bzang po gyon te/ bde ba'i stan la 'dug nas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med pa bzhi dang bcas pa sngon du gtang stai/ oṃ swā bhā wa shung+ngha sarba dhar+m+ma swa bhā wa shung+nghau3 haṃ/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma dang*/ raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang gi sems nyid hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod| sems can gyi don byas/ byang phyogs lcang lo can gyi pho brang du rgyal chen rnam thos sras kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ tshur 'dus hūm̐ la thim/ rdo rje hūm̐ dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid dpal phyag na rdo rje sku mdog :in+t+ra la'i [ in+d+ranī ] lhun po ltar mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi g.yas pas gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon thugs kar sdig 'dzub mdzad pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum/ g.yon brkyang ba'i tshul gyi gdug pa can thams cad mnan par rdzis shing stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs dang dar sngon po'i stod g.yogs bgos ba/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan zhing*| mche ba rnon po bzhi brtsigs pa/ sma ra dang*/ smin ma dang*/

dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes shing*/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan sogs dang*/ klu chen po brgyad kyis sku la brgyan pa/ khro gnyer rab tu bsdus shing*/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs khar hūm̐/ hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rang 'dra'i ye shes sems pa spyan drangs| dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ slar yang hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis/ rigs lnga 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pañca ku la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tits+tsha ye swāhā/ pa d+yāṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhuṣ+pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wā+e t+ya/ shap+ta pra tits+tsha ye swāhā ces pas mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de rnams kyi rin po che'i bum pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba thogs tai/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang*| oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing dbang bskur/ lus gang*/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan dbang gi lha rnams kyang gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ bha ga wan badz+ra pa ṇi ar+ghaṃ pra tats+tshi swāhā sogs/ rang gi thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ gi tha mar sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od 'phros/ dgra gegs thams cad dang*/ khyad par gnod sbyin gdug pa can thams cad tshar gcad/ rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs kar phog pas rang gi dbang du gyur par bsam/ oṃ nī laṃ wa ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa ci nus bzlas pa'i thar*/ yang*/ mchod bstod smon lam bsdus pa dang bcas pa bya'o/ /de nas gtor ma ku sha'i chun pos blangs pa'i dri bzang gi chus bsang gtor bya zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kun+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa= stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las baṃ yongs su gyur pa las/ rin po che sna bzhi las grub pa'i ri rab lhun po gru bzhi pa/

rtsa ba bang rim bzhi dang rtse mo lcog bzhis rnam par mdzes pa/ de'i steng gi dbus su bh+ruṃ yongs su gyur pa las/ rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i pho brang gzhal med khang chen po khang brtsegs rim pa gsum dang ldan pa gsum ka'ang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs dang bcas shing*/ shar shel/ lho baiḍūr+ya/ nub pad+ma rā ga byang gser las grub pa'i/ ka ba nyis stong lnga brgyas ngos re nas gtegs pa'i steng du rin po che'i brgya phugs mdzes pas bkab pa'i sne mo la drwa ba dang drwa phyed/ me long dang*/ rnga yab/ ba dan/ dril bu g.yer kha 'phyang ba/ de dag gi steng du rin po che'i shar bu dang mda' yab kyis mdzes par bskor zhing gdugs dang rgyal mtshan la sogs pa tshar du sgrengs pa'i khang rtsegs kyi steng gi rtse mor zla phyed nor bu rin po che'i tog gis spras shing rtsa bar gter gyi khang pa bco lngas brgyan pa'i phyi'i phyogs mtshams brgyad du yang rin po che'i khang brtsegs rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa brgyad/ de rnams kyi phyi rol du rin po che'i 'khor sa rim pa gsum gyis bskor ba'i phyir rol du dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i gter chen po'i bum pa brgyad/ dpag bsam gyi shing brgyad dang*/ rin po che'i ljon shing 'bras bus brgyan pa brgyad/ rdzing bu bzang po rin chen sna tshogs gyis gang zhing chu bya sna tshogs skad snyan sgrog pa brgyad/ 'dod 'jo'i ba bzang po brgyad rnams spel mar gnas pa'i phyi rol du/ rin po che'i ra ba gru bzhi pas mdzes par bskor ba/ mdor na phyi nang kun tu lha dang mi'i 'dod dgu'i dpal 'byor ma tshang ba med pas kun nas spras pa'o/ /pho brang chen po'i nang gi dbus su/ hrī las pad+ma dmar po'am sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa'i steng du bai ser po las byung ba'i rin po che'i rgyal mtshan tog la bai ser pos mtshan pa/

de las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas sems can thams cad kyi dbul zhing 'phongs pa'i sdug bsngal ma lus pa bsal 'jig rten khams kyi dpal 'byor thams cad bsdus te bai la thim pas/ rgyal mtshan bai dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi bu sku mdog gser btso ma'i mdangs ltar gsal zhing nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi brjid dang ldan pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis g.yas pas dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i rin po che'i rgyal mtshan gyi yu ba thugs kar 'dzin zhing*/ g.yon pas rin po che sna tshogs skyug pa'i gter gyi ne'u le'i mgrin pa nas sta zur g.yon pa'i thad du 'dzin pa/ rab tu 'dzum zhing cung zad bzhad pa'i zhal nas rin po che'i char pa 'bebs pas skye dgu 'phongs pa las sgrol ba/ cung zad zlum zhing*/ rab tu gsal ba'i spyan gnyis kyi nyi ma dang zla ba'i gzi brjid zil gyis gnon pa/ smin ma'i dbus su khro nyer cung zad bsdud pas yid tsam khro zhing sgeg pa dang dpa' ba dang shin tu rol pa'i stabs kyi seng ge dkar po gdong gyen du phyogs zhing rgyan tham cad kyi brgyan pa'i steng na/ zhabs gnyis sems dpa'i dkyil dkrungs kyis bzhugs shing nam mkha' mdzod la mnga' :bsnyes [ brnyes ] pa/ sku la rin po che'i rgyan gyis rnam pa mtha' yas pas brgyan zhing dar sna tshogs kyi na bzas sku klubs pa/ phrag pa g.yas pa nyi ma dang/ g.yon la zla bas brgyan zhing*/ mtshan yid la dran pa tsam gyis srid zhi'i dbul 'phongs sel bar mdzad pa yab yum sras dang bcas pa'o/ khang brtsegs kyi shar du/ dzaṃ ser po las byung ba'i dzam+bha la ser po g.yas rin po che 'dzin pa/ lhor paṃ ser po las byung ba'i gang ba bzang po ser po g.yas bum pa/ nub du maṃ dkar po las byung ba'i nor bu bzang po dkar po nor bu 'dzin pa/ byang du kaṃ nag po las byung ba'i ku be ra nag po g.yas ral gri 'dzin pa/ shar lhor saṃ ser po las byung ba'i yang dag shes ser po gser gri 'dzin pa/

lho nub tu gaṃ nag po las byung ba'i 'brog gnas nag po g.yas mdung dmar 'dzin pa/ nub byang du paṃ ser skya las byung ba'i lnga chen ser skya g.yas khang brtsegs 'dzin pa/ byang shar du saṃ dkar po las byung ba'i 'jam po 'khyil ba dkar po g.yas gri :phub [ gug ] 'dzin pa/ de thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yon thams cad gter gyi ne'u le thogs shing rang rang gi mdog dang mthun pa'i rta mchog rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i steng na dpa' zhing brjid la rngams pa'i tshul gyi gzhugs pa'o/ de'i phyi rol 'khor sa bar pa la/ shar du nor rgyas ser po/ lhor pad ma dkar po/ /nub tu karko ṭa nag po/ byang du 'jog po dmar po/ shar lhor ho lun ta sngon po/ lho nub tu rigs ldan ljang khu/ nub byang du dung skyong ser po/ byang shar du pad chen dkar po/ de thams cad kyang bstod lha'i lus can sbrul mgo'i gdeng ka dang ldan zhing*/ smad sbrul mjug 'khyil ba/ phyag gnyis thal mo sbyar ba'i bar na rin po che 'dzin pas 'dod rgu'i char 'bebs pa'o/ /'khor sa tha ma'i nang rim kyi cha la sde dpon nyi shu rtsa brgyad gnas pa ni/ shar du/ ring po/ mig bzang*/ gang po/ ser skya stai bzhi/ lhor seng ge nye ba'i seng ge dung can/ dga' bo te bzhi/ nub tu/ seng ge seng ge'i ral pa/ bla ma/ ser skya ste bzhi/ byang du 'dzin pa/ 'dzin dga'/ brtson skyong*/ khyab 'jug te bzhi/ byang shar du lnga spyod/ shar lhor tshig lnga ser po/ lho nub du ri mnyam/ nub byang du ser can te/ de rnams nor bu'i rigs so/ /shar du sa pa/ lhor shin tu sa pa/ nub du nag po/ byang du nye nag te de rnams glang po che'i rigs so/ /byang shar du nyi ma/ shar lhor zla ba/ lho nub du me/ nub byang du rlung te de rnams ba glang gi rigs so/ /de thams cad kyang mdog dmar nag cung zad khros pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi g.yas ral gri dang*/ g.yon phub 'dzin pa'o/

/de'i phyir rim gyis cha la stobs chen sum cu so gnyis gnas pa ni/ shar du/ dbang po/ zla ba/ chu bdag skye dgu'i bdag po/ gdos pa'i rgyan/ dbang ldan/ tsan dan/ 'dod pa'i gtso bo stai brgyad/ lhor mgrin ngan/ mgul nges/ ba ḍi/ nor bu/ nor bu spyod| sgra rab/ nye lnga so/ /ri mnyam te brgyad/ nub tu gser can/ gang po/ seng ldeng pa/ g.yon phyogs lha/ ba lang skyong*/ 'brog nas/ mi'i dbang po/ rgyal ba'i khyu mchog te brgyad/ byang du tshig lnga ser po/ bzhin bzang*/ ring po/ dri za sna tshogs sde/ 'bras bu gsum pa/ mgul pa gsum pa/ lcags mdung ring po| lha las byung ba'i ma lhan te brgyad/ de thams cad ni sa ga'i rigs/ mdog ljang nag go cha bgos shing mdung dang ral gri 'dzin pas dmag dpon gyi tshul du gnas pa'o/ /gzhan yang me tog gi ljongs na gnas pa'i gnod sbyin gser gyi yan lag la sogs pa ljongs chen gnas pa bcu drug skya nor bu'i yul na gnas pa'i sde dpon 'khor ba 'jig la sogs pa yul 'khor skyong ba lnga brgya| 'phrog ma chen mo bu lnga brgya dang bcas pa/ shing rta dang mgrin ring la sogs pa'i srin mo chen mo bdun/ thams cad mthong dang pad+ma 'chang la sogs pa'i ma mo chen mo brgyad/ mi gdug pa'i mgo brnyan sna tshogs la sogs pa stai gnod sbyin bye ba'i 'khor thams cad mdog gcig tu ma nges pa/ g.yas mtshon cha sna tshogs dang*/ g.yon gter gyi ne'u le 'dzin pa/ nam mkha' la sprin spungs 'khrigs pa lta bu'o/ /bsdus pa byed na/ rta bdag brgyad kyi rjes la/ 'khor sa bar pa la klu brgyad/ tha ma'i nang rim la sde dpon nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ phyi rim la stobs chen sum cu rtsa gnyis/ gzhan yang ljongs chen gnas pa bcu drugayul 'khor skyong ba lnga brgya/ 'phrog ma bu dang bcas pa/ srin mo bdun/ ma mo brgyad| mgo brnyan sna tshogs la sogs pa rang rang gi chas su zhugs zhing rgyal chen gyi bka' nyan pa/

rang rang gi sde skyong zhing thub pa'i bstan pa bsrung ba'o/de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ rang nyid dpal phyag na rdo rjer gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pa'i sna la khro bo 'dod rgyal dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas lcags kyu dang*/ g.yon zhags pa thogs pa 'phros te/ byang phyogs lcang lo can gyi pho brang nas rgyal po chen po ngal sos po 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs par gyur par bsam zhing*/ 'bras phye dang*/ spos dkar gu gul gyi 'dug spos dang*/ tsan dan dang a ka ru la sogs pa bsreg cing*/ dbyangs byed na rnga brdung mi byed na rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ hūm̐ mgon po kun gshegs thugs dam can/ /da lta snyigs ma lnga yi dus| |bdag can nyon mongs 'dam byings pas/ /mtshams med lnga ni kun spyod phyir/ /ma dag 'byor pa chung zhing dman/ /gzigs shing bzhugs pa'i gnas ngan yang*/ /shākya seng ge'i spyan sngar khyod/ /thugs dam gang bzhed 'dir dgongs la/ /'dren pa'i bstan pa bsrung ba dang*/ /bdag cag rnam la phan gdags phyir/ /byang phyogs gnas na bzhugs pa yi/ /rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /gnas 'dir myur du gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ bai shra wa ṇa sa pa ri wā ra a kar+ṣ+ya dzaḥ zhes brjod cing rol mo drag tu dkrol/ rgyal po dam tshig pa'i thugs kar pad+ma 'dam ma brgyad kyi 'dab ma re re la bai re re bsam zhing*/ bai ring brjid dang bcas pa mig 'dzums sum cu so gcig gi tshad du brjod pas dam tshig pa dang*/ ye shes pa'i thugs 'od zer gyi lcags kyus sbrel bar gyur par bsam zhing*/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod byon pa'i rtags snying 'dar ba dang lus sbrid pa sogs dang grogs la babs pa sogs 'byung*/ ma byung na lan gsum gyi bar du spyan 'dren sngar bzhin bya/ de nas/ oṃ rat+na mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐| zhes pas rin po che'i cod pan gyis dbang bskur bar gyur/

bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir/ /nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu yis ni/ /ji srid mchod pa bdag bgyis na/ /de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ bai shra wa ṇa sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ hūm̐/ mi 'jigs seng ge'i khri steng na/ /bai las byung ba'i mgon po ni/ /ngal sos dge ba stobs po che/ /sa brgyad dbang phyug khyod la bstod/ /btsun mo bzhi dang sras bzhi dang*/ /gnod sbyin brgyad dang klu chen brgyad/ /lha srin sde brgyad 'khor bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /dgra gegs ma lus gzhom pa dang*/ /'byor pa'i longs spyod phun tshogs zhing*/ /'dod rgyu yid bzhin 'grub pa dang*/ /gzhan don lhun gyis 'grub par mdzod/ /rang gi thugs kha'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas rgyal chen bskul ba'i rkyen gyis de'i thugs kar zla ba'i dbus su bai ser po'i mtha' mar sngags kyis bskor ba dang 'khor rnams kyang rang rang gi thugs kar zla ba'i steng du sa bon gyi mtha' mar sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od zer dmar po 'phros te 'jig rten gyi khams kyi dpal dang 'byor pa dbang phyug mthu stobs phun sum tshogs pa thams cad bsdus te rang gi thugs kar thim pas dngos grub thams cad thob par bsam zhing*/ lce rdo rje rtse gsum par gyur par bsams la/ oṃ bai shra wa ṇā ya swāhā/ zhes pa snying po'i sngags gang 'grub kyi mthar gzungs ring/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ hi li ma ṇi bha dra/ hi li hi li ma ṇi bha dra/ ki li ma ṇ-i bha dra/ ki li ki li ma ṇi bha dra/ ku ru ma ṇi bha dra/ ku ru ku ru ma ṇi bha dra/ tu ru ma ṇi bha dra/ tu ru tu ru ma ṇi bha dra/ su ru ma ṇi bha dra/ su ru su ru ma ṇi bha dra/ tsu ru ma ṇi bha dra/ tsu ru tsu ru ma ṇi bha dra/ oṃ e h+ye hi tiṣ+tha tiṣ+tha sarba ar+tha me sā dha ya swāhā/ tad+ya thā/ sū rā ti/ su ra me/ su ra me/ su ma ti su su ṣe/

hi li mi li swāhā/ zhes pa'am/ gzhung gzhan nas/ /tiṣ+tha tiṣ+tha'i rjes la/ a ba ta ra tiṣ+ṭhan+tu me/ a tsa la/ tad+ya thā/ bung+ngha ni/ su dha ni/ su ra se/ hi li mi li swāhā/ zhes 'byung ba gang 'grub bdun nam nyer gcig la sogs pa bzlas/ de nas/ oṃ dzam+bha lā ya swāhā/ oṃ pur+ṇa bha dra ya swāhā/ oṃ ma ṇi bha dra ya swā hā/ oṃ ku be rā ya swāhā/ oṃ sam pra dz+nyā nā ya swāhā/ oṃ gu has+thā na ya swāhā/ oṃ pi tsi kun+ḍa lī ya swāhā/ zhes pas rta bdag brgyad/ oṃ aṣ+ta ma hā na ga ya swāhā/ zhes pas klu chen brgyad/ oṃ ma hā se na pa ti aṣ+ta biṃ sha ta ya swāhā/ zhes pas sde dpon nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ oṃ ma hā ba la ḍā tiṃ shata swāhā/ zhes pas stobs chen sum cu rtsa gnyis/ spro na klu la sogs pa rnams kyi mtshan sngags so so ci 'grub kyis bzlas brjod sems ma yengs par byas la/ mchod pa rgyas par bshams/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bha bas sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i snod yangs zhing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ngam/ khaṃ zhu ba las byung pa'i bsang gtor/ mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ nyer spyod/ rol mo/ 'dod yon lnga/ rin chen bdun/ bkra shis brgyad la sogs pa thun mong dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i mchod sprin/ dwangs zhing thogs pa med pa/ rang bzhin stong nyid rnam pa mchod rdzas/ rgya khyon nam mkha'i khams gang ba/ byed las rgyal chen mnyes nas dngos grub kyi char chen po 'bebs par gyur| oṃ sarbā bid pu ra pu ra/ su ra su ra a warta ya/ a warta ya hoḥ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pa gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ de nas/ dge legs rin chen 'byung gnas legs 'ong pa'i/ /mkha' khyab rin chen gsang gtor mchod sprin 'di/ /bstan bsrungs rin chen mang la bdag 'bul na// dngos grub rin chen char rgyun myur du stsol/ /oṃ badz+ra dha ra bai shra wa ṇa sa pa ri wā ra prog+sha ṇaṃ pra tits+tsha swāhā/

de bzhin du yon chab/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos| snang gsal/ dri mchogazhal zas sil snyan rnams la/ ar+ghaṃ/ pad+yaṃ/ añca ma naṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhuṣ+pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ naiwi te/ shap+ta rnams sbyar ro/ /phun tshogs lha yi dpal 'byor bla na med/ yid 'phrog mig gi bdud rtsi gzugs mdzes kun/ /yid mdzes gnas bsrungs 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /bde chen 'dod rgu'i dpal 'byor kun stsol cig de bzhin du rna ba'i bdud rtsi sgra snyan kun/ /sna yi bdud rtsi dri mchog kun/ /lce yi bdud rtsi ro bcud kun// lus kyi bdud rtsi reg 'jam kun/ /zhes pa rnams dang*/ ru pa/ shap+ta/ gan+dha/ ra sa| spar+sha/ rnams kā ma gu ṇas brgyan ba dang sbyor/ dpag yas bsod nams kyis bsgrub lha yi rdzas/ /'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal srid mi yi nor/ /rtsibs stong 'khor lo rin chen 'di phul bas/ /chos dang nor gyi rgyal srid kun thob shog |tsakra rat+na de bzhin du/ /bsam 'phel nor bu= rab mdzes btsun mo=/ dbang bsgyur blon po= /stobs ldan glang po= /lcang shes rta mchog= mdzod 'dzin khyim bdag rnams dang*/ ma ṇi/ wasti/ mahā ta/ hasti/ a shwa/ gri ha pa ti rnams sbyar ro/ /rgyal bas byin gyis brlabs pa'i bkra shis rdzas/ /lcang lo can gyi pho brang mdzes pa'i rgyan/ /dri med chos kun gsal ba'i me long 'di/ /phul bas bkra shis 'dod rgu kun stsol cig /ā dar+sha maṅga la/ de bzhin du g.yas 'khyil chos sgra snyan par sgrog pa'i dung*/ /nyon mongs dug gsum 'joms pa'i gi ham 'di| |stong gsum rtsi bcud kun gyi snying po zho/ chos kun dbang du bsdud pa'i li khri 'di/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i tshe 'phel dur ba'i rtswa/ /rgyu rkyen 'bras bur bsdus pa'i bil ba 'di/ /bgegs kyi bar chad kun 'joms yungs kar 'di// zhes pa rnams dang*/ shaṃ kha go ro tsa na/ da dhi/ li khri/ dur ba/ bil ba/ par+sha pa rnams maṅga las brgyan pa dang sbyar/

de bzhin du bkra shis rtags brgyad la'ang*/ rkang pa gsum pa la/ phyogs kun bkra shis mtshon byed dpal be'u 'di/ zhes dang*| dpal be'u gnas su/ 'khor lo/ pad+ma/ rgyal mtshan/ gdugs mdzes/ bum pa/ dung dkar/ gser nya rnams bcug pa dang*/ shrī wasta la/ tsakra/ pad+ma/ dhā tsha/ ts+tsha gram gtata gha ṭa/ shaṃ kha/ pu war+ṇa mat+na rnams sbyar ro/ /de nas spro na/ zlum zhing gzi 'bar lcags ri'i 'khor yug can/ /chos nor kun tshang gling bzhi gling phran dang*/ /gser ris bskor ba'i rol mtshor bcas pa kun/ /rgyal chen rnam sras 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa mu ge bh+yaḥ sarba thā khaṃ/ ud ga te s+pha ra na i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ grih+ṇa s+t+waṃ swā hā/ de bzhin du rkang pa bzhi pa dang sngags kun la sbyar nas/ de dbus rab brjid rin chen lhun po'i steng*| |rim gsum yid 'phrog khang brtsegs gzhal med khang*/ /gru bzhi sgo bzhi rab mdzes rta babs can/ /ces dang*/ rin chen khri dang skyon bral pad zla dang*| |rab brjid gyen du phyogs pa gdong lnga'i gdan/ /rgyal mtshan ne'u le rin chen rgyan mchog rnams/ zhes dang/ kun da nyi zla lha rdzas nam bza' dang*// gter chen bzhi dang mi zad gter bco lnga/ khang brtsegs brgyad dang 'khor sa rim pa gsum/ /zhes dang/ dgos 'dod byung ba'i gter chen bum pa brgyad// dpag bsam shing brgyad rin chen ljon shing brgyad/ /rdzing bu rta mchog 'dod 'jo'i ba brgyad rnams/ zhes dang*/ shing thog sna tshogs rin chen 'bru rnams dang*| |dkar gsum mngar gsum bdud rtsi'i zas mchog dang*/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i dam rdzas bla med rnams*/ /rgyal chen rnam sras 'khor dang bcas la 'bul| |na maḥ swau/ de nas bstod pa ni/ rin chen pho brang la che chung gnyis la sogs pa bya zhing*/ bu ston rin po che yis mdzad pa'i bstod chen yang grub na bya/ ma grub na 'di ltar/ dpal phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/

/dpal ldan chos bsrung lcang lo can gyi bdag /rnam thos sras por grags pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin/ /sna tshogs skur ston sras 'khor dpag med can/ /thub bstan rdzaugs par skyong der bstod par bgyi/ khyod kyi gnas ni byang phyogs lcang lo can/ /rin chen bye bas bsgrubs pa'i gzhal med khang*/ /'dod rgu'i dpal 'byor kun rdzogs lhun po'i rgyan| zla med lha yi gnas la phyag 'chal lo/ khyod kyi yab ni drang srong dka' thub can/ rig byed rnams mang thos pa'i lha chen dang*/ khyod yum lha mo dpal ldan zhes bya las/ khyod 'khrungs mtshan du srid sgrub btags la 'dud/ khyod mtshan lha rnams kyis bstod rnam thos sras/ /lha min sgra gcan mgul phreng rab rgod kyi/ /dmag rnams bzlog tshe de gsum gyis bstod nas/ /ngal gsos gnas bsrungs lus ngan btags la 'dud/ /rnal 'byor rgyud dang 'dus par dbang bskur nas/ khyod mtshan rdo rje 'jigs byed zhes byar btags/ /rnal 'byor nam mkha' drag po chen po dang*/ /dus kyi 'khor lor gnod sbyin btags la 'dud/ khyod sku 'dod rgu'i dpal 'byor rgyas phyir du/ /seṅge'i khri la gser mdog gzi 'od 'bar/ /rin chen rgyal mtshan gter gyi ne'u le 'dzin// yon tan mtha' dag rdzogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ khams gsum dbang du :bdud

[ bsdud ] phyir khyod mdog dmar/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis be con ne'u le 'dzin| |seṅge'i steng du rin chen rgyan mang 'chang*/ /las mkhan mdung dmar g.yon na 'gying la 'dud/ sdug bsngal zhi phyir ljang ser zhi ba'i mdog /rin chen gyis spras ral gri rgyal mtshan g.yas/ /g.yon pa spar bu rin chen ne'u le 'dzin| |ngang pa gser mdog chib la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ma rungs 'dul phyir mthing nag khro bo'i gzugs/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas kyi dbyug pa 'phyar| |phyag g.yon chos sku'i mchod rten thugs kar 'dzin/ khro bo'i nyams kun rdzogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ khyod gsung yan lag drug cus chos 'khor bskor| |las bzhi'i rigs sngags sgrog la 'gro dbugs 'byin/ khyod thugs khro chags zhi sogs nyams kun rdzogs/ /spros bral byams brtses bltams la phyag 'tshal lo/ khyod sras thun mong stobs chen dgu bcu gcig khyad par sde chen bzhi dang las sgrub gsum/ /bla med sras po gar mkhan mchog rnams ni// kun kyang gnod byin du mas bskor la 'dud/ /thun mong kun kyang dbang po'i ming can ste/ /kun rgyal bskyed po gdon chen bum pa'i lto/ /rgyal ba khyu mchog rmug 'dzin gnod gnas dbang*/ /rim bzhin bzhi dang gsum por grags la 'dud| khyod 'khor blun po zla med rta bdag brgyad/ /tshes spun sde dpon stobs chen klu chen dang*/ /ljaungs chen gnas dang 'khor skyong 'phrog ma bu/ /srin mo ma mo sna tshogs gzugs la 'dud/ /nyan thos ltar na khyod sngon 'od bsrung dus// mkha' lding sgra chung zhes byar gyur pa'i tshe/ /dkon mchog skyabs song shākya seṅge'i tshe| |bstan bsrung bden pa mthong la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang sems ltar na bden pa'i zla bar khyod/ gyur tshe thugs bskyed da ltar sa brgyad brnyes/ /ma 'ongs dus na rin chen gdugs zhes bya'i/ /rgyal bar lung bstan thob la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gsang sngags ltar na bya rgyud rigs drug dang*/

/spyod pa'i rgyud dang rnal 'byor rigs lnga'i rgyud/ /bla med pha ma gnyis med rgyud rnams su/ /dbang bskur rgyud kun 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /la lar sa bcu'i byang sems rin chen mang*/ /gnod sbyin chen por sprul zhes rgyal bas gsungs/ /bde gshegs rnam snang mdzad kyi sprul par yang*/ /rdo rje 'dzin pas bshad la phyag 'tshal lo// mchod pa kun 'bul sdig pa mtha' dag bshags/ /dge la yi rang chos 'khor bskor du gsol/ /mgon khyod rtag bzhugs thub bstan lhag par skyongs// dge bas 'gro kun khyod dang mtshungs par shog /ces pas bstod/ gzhan yang khro bu lo tsā bas mdzad pa'i yan lag bdun pa ni/ rgyal chen rnam thos sras ni nor mang ldan/ /gser ri lhun po lta bur brjid mdzes 'gying*/ /sprin bral nyi 'od stong gi gzi ldan pa'i/ /'dod rgu'i char chen 'bebs la phyag 'tshal lo// mkha' khyab yid 'ong lha rdzas dngos kun dang*/ /bka' 'bangs bran slad rang lus nyer stobs bcas/ /ma chags mi zhum zab dang rgya che'i phyir/ /dgos 'dod sgrub phyir dge tshogs rgya mtshos mchod/ /rang gi rgyu sngon ma bsags 'bras 'dod dang*/ /don med don log cung zad don gyi phyir/ /ha cang 'dod chen bskyed dang chog mi shes/ /bsam sbyor nongs pa gang bgyis 'thol lo gshags| |lha klu mi rnams 'jigs dang 'phongs pa las/ /myur skyob 'jig rten skyob rgyal 'jig rten dang*/ /kun sgrol kun la phan dang bde ster ba'i// phrin las rgyun mi chad la rjes yi rang*/ /sna tshogs ya nga 'jigs dang mgon med dang*/ /sdig sdug dngos 'phongs brgyal gzir skal ngan dang*/ /dbugs dbyung slad du thugs gsung sku dang 'od/ /nyi zla rgyal mtshan ne'u le rnam rol bskul| khyod sku khro dang 'dzum dang brjid mdzes 'gying*/ /sgeg dul ldan 'jigs dpa' bo'i gar dgu yis/ /mi bsrun tshar gcad skal ldan rjes bzung phyir| |bskal brgyar mya ngan mi 'da' bdag gsol 'debs/

/de ltar 'gro ba skyob la 'gro gter slad/ /lha mchog lhag pa'i lhar bzung bsnyen bkur bas// bdag sogs mgon med mgon mdzad rtag tu yang*/ /shes rab thugs rjes mi snyel mi gtong shog /ces bsam pa drag pos brjod/ de nas gtor ma ni/ 'dir zhi ba nor sgrub kyi dbang du byas nas/ rin po che'i snod gas chag med par 'bras sam nas kyi zan gtsang ma dkar gsum mngar gsum gyis brgyan pa| rta rkyang gi sha ma gtogs pa'i dmar rgyan dang bcas shing chang spangs pa legs par bshams la/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+ruṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du khaṃ yongs su gyur pa las| lha'i zhal zas ro brgya dang ldan pa phun sum tshogs pa 'dod pa'i yon tan lngas brgyan par gyur pa'i steng du/ oṃ dkar po/ āḥdamar po/ hūm̐ sngon po rim gyis rtsegs pa 'od du zhu ba'i rkyen gyis rdzas rnams kyang zhu nas dri ma thams cad sbyangs par gyur/ oṃ ā kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dhar+m+ma ṇaṃ ā d+ya nutan+pan twa ta oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum bzlas pas rgya cher spel bar gyur/ oṃ ru ru s+phu ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sid+dhi lo tsā na sarba ar+tha sa dha na swāhā/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga to bh+yo bi shwa nas/ grih+nā s+t+waṃ lan gsum bzlas/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi kha dog dri ro reg bya yon tan thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ oṃ nī laṃ wa ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi la ā kā ro btags pa gsum dang*/ oṃ be shra wa ṇa sa pa ri wa ra i daṃ ba liṃ ta gṛh+na tu sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu ma ma sarba sing+ngh-im+me pra ya ts+tshan+tu ma ma sarba karmā ar+tha sā dha ni a mo gha swāhā zhes pa gsum dang*/ oṃ dzaṃ bha lā ya swāhā/ zhes pa nas/ pi tsi kun+ṭa li ye swāhā/ i daṃ nas| a mo gha swāhā zhes pa gsum dang*/ klu la sogs pa la/ ā kā ros lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ sngar bzhin mchod pa bsdus pa dang*/ bstod pa bsdus pas bstod la/

byang phyogs skyong ba'i rgyal chen rnam thos sras/ /gtor ma phul ba 'di dag bzhes su gsol/ /gtor ma phul ba 'di dag bzhes nas kyang*| |bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la/ /bu sdug bzhin du skyong bar mdzad du gsol/ /bdag la gnod par sems pa yi/ /log par zhugs pa'i sems can rnams/ /de yi khru ma gzhom pa dang*/ gtan nas rlag pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod kyi/ las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /mthu dang rdzu 'phrul che mnga' ba'i/ /gnod sbyin bdag po khyed rnams kyis/ /bdag gi bsam pa ma lus pa/ /myur du rdzogs par mdzad du gsol| |rdo rje 'chang dbang phyag na rdo rje dang*/ /spyod mdzad chos kyi rdo rje kun tu bzang*/ /'gro bzang snying po rin chen rdo rje dang*/ kha che dgon pa zangs dkar lo ts+tsha ba/ /g.yor po jo ston bsod nams rin chen dang*/ /pad+ma bkra shis bstags pa jo bzang dang*/ /byams pa lo ts+tsha bsod dbang bsod seng dang*// rin chen seng ge bu ston chos kyi rje/ /rin chen rnam rgyal rin chen bsod nams 'phel| |dngos grub kun bstsol 'jam dbyangs chos kyi rje/ rgyal ba kun dngos bla ma mchog rnams kyi/ /bka' dang dam tshig mtha' dag tshul bzhin du// bsgrubs te rnal 'byor bdag gi bsam pa'i don/ /las bzhi'i phrin las 'tha' dag gegs med du/ /bsams pa tsam gyis 'grub pa'i phrin las la/ /g.yel ba med par mdzad nas phyogs kun tu/ /phan bde'i dpal 'byor mtha' dag rgyas par mdzod/ /ces pa sogs kyis gsol ba gdab cing thugs dam legs par bskul/ rgyal chen rnam thos sras kyi gtor bsgrub dngos grub kyi rgya mtsho zhes bya ba/ dge slong skad gnyis smra ba shes rab rin chen rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos sbyar ba dge bar gyur cig /bkra shis shog/ // mes po'i shul bzhag gi dpe tshogs las/ stag tshang lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen gyi bka' 'bum/rgyal chen rnam thos sras kyi gtor chen dngos grub rgya mtsho/
